lines.text: Many learners say: I look forward to see you.
Better: I look forward to seeing you.
Meeting! I look forward to meeting you.

data.wrong: I look forward to see you.
data.right: I look forward to seeing you.

native.hook: look forward to 后面用 ing！
native.tip: 中文“期待见到你”里，动词形式不变。英语的 look forward to 里，to 是介词，后面要用 ing 形式。
native.caption: 你是不是也会说 “I look forward to see you.”😅 中文动词不变形，英语这里的 to 后要加 ing：“I look forward to seeing you.”跟着 Ama 老师读一读！在 Lexkite 应用里练习更多。
native.comment: 答案：“I look forward to seeing you.”大声读一遍，再写一句你自己的句子。免费测验在这里：{link}

en.tip: Chinese verbs stay the same, but in English look forward to needs ing.
en.caption: Do you say “I look forward to see you.” 😅 Look forward to needs ing: “I look forward to seeing you.” Listen to Ama and repeat! Practice more in the Lexkite app.
